[NDET.3.3] The accessor reports `ds_version` (the DS version that wrote the
stream, a string), `session_id`, `tier_id` and the dialect-binding tuple
([RBND.1.3]): `dsc_hash`, `capabilities` and `dialect_def_sha256`. The rest of
the `StreamHeader` ([RFCS.4]) — the wall-clock anchor and the RT-config binding
— is not exposed through it.
